faces.name: Crime Novelist
faces.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and add {R}.

faces.name: Crime
faces.oracleText: Put target creature or enchantment card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

faces.name: Punishment
faces.oracleText: Destroy each artifact, creature, and enchantment with mana value X.

faces.name: Crime Scene
faces.oracleText:
While voting, you may vote an additional time.
When you planeswalk here and whenever chaos ensues, each player secretly votes for a creature and then the results are revealed. Destroy each creature that received the most votes or tied for most votes. Put two +1/+1 counters on each other creature that received at least one vote.

faces.name: Crimestopper Sprite
faces.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 6. (Exile cards with total mana value 6 or greater from your graveyard.)
Flying
When this creature enters, tap target creature. If evidence was collected, put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)

faces.name: Criminal Enterprise
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, create a 2/1 black Villain creature token with menace. (It can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Whenever a Villain you control dies, this enchantment deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.

faces.name: Criminal Past
faces.oracleText: Commander creatures you own have menace and "This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard." (A creature with menace can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)

faces.name: Crimson Acolyte
faces.oracleText:
Protection from red

faces.name: Crimson Caravaneer
faces.oracleText:
